description: Andee lives on your phone or Mac and uses any app like you do—no integrations, no root, any model; memory and passwords never leave your device | Andee 住进你的手机或 Mac，像你一样操作任何 App——无需集成、无需 Root、支持任意模型，记忆和密码绝不离开设备。
summary: An agent that moves into your Android phone and becomes its soul — not an assistant, not a tool. Any app, no integrations, on-device, one APK.
